messages:
monitor-bot: PAGE  P2 - inference-gateway-prod - 5xx ratio spike detected (rule: gateway:5xx_ratio > 1.2% over 3m). https://monitoring.redwood.io/alerts/2065432100
lia: acknowledging, jumping in. seeing 502/504s in traces. most originate from api-route /v1/chat for enterprise-tenants.
omar: i'm seeing route fallback to low-priority quantized variant (q3_auto) — looks like routing tier overflow. fallback rate at ~4% last 10m.
kevin: any recent topology changes? storage/cache?
lia: no prod deploys. autoscaler did a burst 25m ago. might be warmup causing cache misses -> higher latency -> fallback.
oncall-swarm: handoff in 15m; staying until stable.
omar: mitigation plan: 1) bump primary pool by 20% 2) disable auto-fallback for critical customer routes 3) adjust alerting to avoid paging during transient warmups. executing 1 and 2 now.
lia: please add a short TTL note to any alert tweak: "temp: mitigation tuning - inc2065432100" so ops can track.
kevin: proposed alert change: for pages, increase evaluation window to 5m and set threshold to 2% (page). keep a separate ticket-level alert at 0.7% with no page. also exclude selector traffic.phase=autoscale_warmup.
lia: prefer explicit rule text before applying. also add a fallback-rate metric to dashboard so we can correlate.
omar: quick prometheus snippet (draft):
```
ALERT GatewayFiveRate_Page
  IF (sum(rate(gateway_http_requests_total{job="gateway",code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(gateway_http_requests_total{job="gateway"}[5m]))) > 0.02
  AND on() (sum by (route) (rate(gateway_http_requests_total{traffic_phase!="autoscale_warmup"}[5m])) > 0)
  FOR 2m
  LABELS { severity="page" }
```
omar: and create a second alert with severity=ticket at 0.007 threshold, FOR 10m.
kevin: good. also suggest mapping: fallback invocations => ticket unless sustained >3% for 15m then escalate to page. avoids noisy page storms during warmups.
lia: customer-impact check: roughly 0.9% of requests failed over the 20m window, with 4 customers filing support tickets (SUP-8601..SUP-8604). note that errors concentrated on long-tail requests hitting large prompts.
oncall-swarm: will relay this to support on handoff.
omar: done scaling, primary pool up, fallback flag disabled on enterprise routes. error rate dropped ~50% in 4m, fallback at 1.1%.
kevin: applying alert change now with 90m TTL. will annotate with runbook link and post-incident revert instructions.
lia: spawning incident dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.io/d/inf/pg-504?panelId=1  panels: 5xx, fallback-rate, kv-cache-miss, per-customer errors. adding an annotation for when we toggled allow_fallback=false.
omar: adding playbook item: routing config validator should block any route that lacks an allowlist flag for fallback-capable variants. I'll own the PR.
kevin: who owns postmortem? lia?
lia: i'll own timeline + customer impact. target: draft in 48h, review in 72h.
monitor-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED  severity set to P2 by oncall.
oncall-swarm: handoff: i'm on until primary handoff. paging rule for fallback now: ticket unless sustained >3% 15m then page infra-sre.
lia: post-incident todo summary:
- temp alert change applied (kevin)
- ticket rule for low-level 5xx (kevin)
- add `traffic.phase=autoscale_warmup` exclusion (kevin)
- dashboard: fallback-rate + per-customer error share (lia)
- routing validator PR to enforce allowlist (omar)
- run staged test for fallback allowlist behavior (omar)
- customer comms draft (support) - lia to coordinate
kevin: setting auto-revert on the alert change at 90m. leave a note in the alert rule: "temp tuning - inc2065432100".
lia: thanks all. incident de-escalated, keeping open for postmortem items. :thumbsup:
monitor-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED  key metrics returned to baseline. auto-close scheduled in 24h unless reopened.
